facility.name: Children's Education Station LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity: 29 children were observed in a room with a capacity of 16.     *Children were moved to a room with a capacity over 40.*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity (26 TAC §746.1505(3))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: Liability insurance was not verified by the operation's permit issuance anniversary date. Date of verification was 06/18/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.205(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 out of 10 childrens records reviewed are missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During rest-time in the after-school room, children were observed watching a cartoon.     *This was corrected at inspection when the T.V was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 5 out 10 staff records reviewed are missing the following:  1) Hazardous Materials, Allergies  2) Hazardous Materials, Allergies, Building safety, Communicable diseases.  3) Hazardous Materials, Allergies, Building safety, Communicable diseases, Medication, Emergency preparedness.   4) Hazardous Materials, Allergies, Building safety, Communicable diseases, Medication, Emergency preparedness.   5) Hazardous Materials, Allergies, Building safety, Communicable diseases, Medication, Emergency preparedness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A section of the turf in the outdoor play area was observed deteriorated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There was one caregiver caring for 18 children. The specified age for the group is 3 years old which allows 15 to 1 caregiver.     Note The ratios were left in compliance as an additional caregiver was put in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two new caregivers did not have an Orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Two new caregivers did not have at least 8 hours  of Preservice training before being counted in ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: Two infant play yards did not have a sheet cover for the mattress.     Corrected at Inspection: Fitted sheets were placed on the mattresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: The operation exceeded the licensed infant capacity at the center. There were 9 additional infants in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The health inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

The following training topics were missing:   -6 hours in one or more of the following topics:   (1)Child growth and development, (2)Guidance and discipline, (3)Age-appropriate curriculum [Medium]; and (4)Teacher-child interaction.     -child maltreatment  -SIDS, shaken baby syndrome, childhood brain development     -(1)Emergency preparedness   (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations   (3)Administering medication   (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety   (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials     --3 hours Management
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))
